title: We Checked 66 L-Carnitine Products. Not One Hit the Studied Dose.
description: 226 Amazon listings narrowed to 66 distinct single-ingredient products. Only 7 use L-carnitine L-tartrate, the form the exercise-recovery trials ran on, and not one delivers the studied 2 g in a single serving. Full method, price table and what the data does not tell you. #LCarnitine #SupplementResearch #Supplements #FuelnFitHub
